purpose: Python-only, aggregate-safe probability-calibration and abstention POC after baseline-003 model selection.

selection_protocol.training: Fit baseline parameters on train only.
selection_protocol.temperature: Select the scalar temperature by calibration-split negative log likelihood only.
selection_protocol.abstention: Select one predeclared confidence threshold on calibration only, maximizing non-abstained macro F1 subject to minimum coverage.
selection_protocol.test: Use once for confirmation after temperature and threshold selection; never tune on test.

temperature.method: multiclass scalar temperature scaling over probability-derived logits

abstention.rule: Abstain when the maximum calibrated class probability is below the selected threshold.
abstention.selection: highest calibration non-abstained macro F1, then higher coverage, then lower threshold

retention: in-memory only; no weights, calibrated predictions, per-record decisions, candidate text, context text, paths, or IDs are written
scope: Research evidence only. This contract does not authorize scanner decisions, a default policy, or a Rust port.
